name: Grand Hyatt Jakarta
short_description: A 415-room Grand Hyatt on Jalan Thamrin, directly connected to Plaza Indonesia mall with an MRT station out front and a Grand Club Lounge.
ai_summary: Grand Hyatt Jakarta sits on Jalan M.H. Thamrin, directly connected to Plaza Indonesia mall with an MRT station right in front, close to Grand Indonesia and government offices. Guests consistently praise the central, convenient location and the Grand Club Lounge's breakfast and evening cocktails, along with a 43-metre lagoon-shaped pool in a Balinese-style garden that reviewers call surprisingly green for an urban hotel. Opened in 1991, the property has been renovated since, but reviews are notably split -- some travelers describe a consistently excellent stay while a vocal minority report significant service and maintenance issues, so it's worth reading recent reviews before booking.

core_facts.address: Jalan M. H. Thamrin Kav. 28-30, Jakarta 10350, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Grand Club Lounge access, including breakfast and evening cocktails, for suite guests and World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability, per World of Hyatt program terms
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Directly connected to Plaza Indonesia mall, with an MRT station right in front
43-metre lagoon-shaped, salt-chlorinated pool in a lush Balinese-style garden
Grand Club Lounge with breakfast and evening cocktails draws consistent praise
Central Thamrin location near Grand Indonesia, government offices, and cultural attractions
Award-winning C's Steak and Seafood restaurant among three on-site dining venues
cons: Reviews are notably split -- a vocal minority report significant service and maintenance issues alongside many strongly positive stays
Some guests report friction with the online check-in process
research_highlights: Guests praise the central, mall-connected location and impeccable cleanliness
The Grand Club Lounge's breakfast and evening cocktails draw consistent, strong praise
The pool and garden setting are called surprisingly green for a central urban hotel
research_watchouts: A vocal minority of reviews report significant service and maintenance issues, a wider spread than at some other Hyatt properties
Some guests raised concerns about how the hotel handled online check-in issues

faqs.question: Is Grand Hyatt Jakarta connected to a mall?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's directly connected to Plaza Indonesia mall, with an MRT station right in front and Grand Indonesia mall nearby, making it one of the most centrally connected hotels in Jakarta's Thamrin business district.

faqs.question: Are reviews of Grand Hyatt Jakarta consistent?
faqs.answer: Not entirely -- most guests report an excellent stay with praise for the location, pool, and Grand Club Lounge, but a vocal minority describe significant service and maintenance issues, so it's worth checking recent reviews close to your travel dates before booking.
